full_name: Cheng-Zhi Anna Huang | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Engineering & Computer Science Rieman and Baketel Fellow for Music Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Creator of the machine learning model that powered Google’s first AI Doodle (the “Bach Doodle”), Cheng-Zhi Anna Huang joined MIT in fall 2024 to launch a new interdisciplinary graduate program in music technology and computation. At Radcliffe, she will collaborate with music ensembles to model music making as a multi-agent system, by learning from interactions between musicians in order to transform how we approach human-AI collaboration.
